task: Clean obsolete local metadata and verify repository-local checks.

args.summary:
Tools for inspecting/editing the repository are unavailable (list_files/run_command returned unknown tool), so no in-repo changes or test runs could be performed. Based on the maintenance note to write caches outside the repository, here is the smallest actionable maintenance plan you can apply locally:

1) Remove obsolete local metadata from the working tree (not meant for version control):
- Delete directories/files if present: .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache, .tox, .cache, .coverage, coverage.xml, htmlcov/, dist/, build/, .parcel-cache, .next/, node_modules/.cache, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db
- Ensure these are not tracked: git rm -r --cached <path> for any that are committed.

2) Ensure future caches live outside the repo (or are ignored):
- Add/confirm .gitignore rules:
  .pytest_cache/
  .mypy_cache/
  .ruff_cache/
  .tox/
  .cache/
  .coverage
  coverage.xml
  htmlcov/
  dist/
  build/
  node_modules/.cache/
  .DS_Store
- Configure common tools to externalize caches when possible:
  - Ruff: set env RUFF_CACHE_DIR (e.g., $XDG_CACHE_HOME/ruff)
  - mypy: set cache_dir in mypy.ini/pyproject (e.g., cache_dir = ${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/mypy)
  - ESLint: use --cache --cache-location $XDG_CACHE_HOME/eslint (and do not commit it)
  - pytest: optionally set cache_dir in pytest.ini if used, or disable cache plugin for CI with -p no:cacheprovider
  - pip/pip-tools: set PIP_CACHE_DIR if needed

3) Verify repository-local checks (run locally since tools aren’t available here):
- If using pre-commit: pre-commit install && pre-commit run -a
- If Makefile exists: make lint and/or make check
- Python: ruff check ., mypy ., pytest -q
- Node: npm run lint && npm test (or pnpm/yarn equivalents)
- tox (if present): tox -e lint,py

4) If any generated metadata was mistakenly committed, remove and re-commit:
- git rm -r --cached .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache .tox .cache htmlcov dist build node_modules/.cache .coverage coverage.xml
- Commit with message: "chore: remove local cache/metadata and enforce ignore rules"

Outcome: With the above, obsolete local metadata is cleaned and prevented from reappearing in version control, and repository-local checks are verified on a developer machine.
